purpose: Pre-recorded source-review criteria for a new video; developer review, not an independent accuracy study

criteria.expected: Cover reported sale of state-owned stakes and the proceeds/target when numeric details are included
Distinguish the stated urgent funding motive from reported transaction facts
Do not invent a currency for the capital outflow amount whose unit is unstated
If extracting the wage/government-closure warning, preserve its explicit condition and future status
Keep the metaphorical criticism distinct from reported facts
Do not infer event calendar years from video metadata

note: Criteria recorded before v6 generation; subsequent v7 rerun is a regression, not a fresh independent evaluation.
